model: read-only input; O(log N) generator/index state; append-only write-only output; symbolic asymptotic analysis

precedent.already_proved: one uniform length-preserving SAT-label-preserving involution E; conservative O(N^2) time O(N) space

increment.peak_space: O(log(N+2)) writable bits including source/index queries and all preprocessing
increment.output: exactly N bits if stream output requested
increment.lazy_access: O(N log^4 N + Q N log^2 N) bit time and O(log N) extra writable space for Q output-bit requests
increment.materialized_access: Omega(N) writable space to retain the N-bit transformed input; rho >= 1

limitations: Host JS stores original input and test outputs, so its memory is not a Turing-machine space measurement.
Pure JS numeric counters use finite machine numbers; symbolic logspace proof uses binary counters with arbitrary finite input size.
Fixed mixed Rmix341 remains unchanged; the involution is not a free proof rule.
The result does not construct an all-input polynomial SAT solver or prove B3.
